issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify Animal.messageOnFeed() as returning a String, but the solution's Animal class declares messageOnFeed() to return FeedResponse. This is an API return-type mismatch that will confuse students about the expected return value and behavior of messageOnFeed().
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the specification: change Animal.messageOnFeed() in the solution to return String (not FeedResponse), and update Pig/Seal implementations to return the required String messages. Alternatively, update the problem statement and UML to document and explain the FeedResponse type if that was intended.

issues.description: Within the solution repository there is an internal inconsistency: Animal.messageOnFeed() is declared to return FeedResponse, but Goat.messageOnFeed() returns String. This causes a method signature mismatch and will prevent the code from compiling as provided.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return types consistent across the solution: either change Animal.messageOnFeed() to return String and have Pig/Seal/Goat return String, or make all subclasses return FeedResponse and update Goat accordingly. Ensure all overrides exactly match the abstract method signature so the project compiles.
